test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Consider the below statements and identify the correct answer.

**Statement - I:** Keeping food in air-tight containers helps to slow down oxidation.

**Statement - II:** Chips manufacturers usually flush bags of chips with gas such as oxygen to prevent the chips from getting oxidised.

options.text: Statement-I is true, and Statement-II is false.
Statement-I is false, and Statement-II is true.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Statement-I is true, and Statement-II is false.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Keeping food in **air-tight containers** helps to** slow down oxidation **as it** reduces t**he exposure of the food to air, which is necessary for oxidation to occur.
 
• Chips manufacturers usually flush bags of chips with gas such as** nitrogen i**nstead of oxygen to prevent the chips from getting oxidized.
 
• This is because nitrogen is an** inert gas **and** does not react **with the chips, thus preventing oxidation.
 
• Statement-I is** true** as keeping food in air-tight containers does slow down oxidation.
 
• Statement-II is **false** as chips manufacturers usually flush bags of chips with nitrogen to prevent oxidation, not oxygen.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The loss of electrons by a molecule, atom, or ion during a reaction is called** oxidation.**
 
• A molecule, atom, or ion undergoes oxidation when its oxidation status** increased. **
 
• Oxidation is a **chemical process** in which oxygen reacts with other substances, such as food, and causes a** change** in their chemical composition.
 
• Air-tight containers **prevent **the entry of oxygen into the container and thus **slow down oxidation.**
